actions.rationale: Sidecar open_positions is empty, so OPEN rather than ADD. Long duration on the locked 2027 CRA strip expresses underpriced Canadian easing versus a 2.29 CORRA benchmark and 38 labor score. $85m of the $100m gross cap leaves $15m unused against energy-pass-through risk while still paying the 3.85% SOFR vig on the full allocation.

events.invalidation: BoC delivers or signals the priced 2027 mid-3s path, or trim/median leave ~2% while jobs stop contracting.
events.rationale: FACT: overnight CORRA is 2.29 and the 2027 3m strip implies 3.13-3.595 while 1m CORRA is only 2.58 by December; August employment was -42k, wages +2.0% y/y, CPI-trim/median 1.9%/2.0%. INFERENCE: 2027 CRA is pricing an energy-pass-through hiking cycle that domestic labor and core do not require, so receiving that window is the underpriced-easing trade. UNKNOWN: whether WTI 107.02, weaker energy shock-absorbers, and Q2 GDP +0.8% still force BoC to validate the strip. Expression is rates-first; spot USDCAD long is the alternative and is inferior because oil and CAD-short covering can hold CAD up even if CRA 2027 reprices lower.
